_why: Narration pace per language, in seconds of finished audio per SCRIPT word (pauses included); studio/script_check.py turns word counts into minutes with it. From EP07 English is the primary language (episode.json "language"). IMPORTANT: the English 0.40 s/word is an ESTIMATE, not a measurement. After the first English recording run: python3 studio/script_check.py 07 --calibrate (add --lang hi for the Hindi reference) and the number below becomes measured. PACE=<s/word> env still overrides for one run.

en.calibrate_after: first English recording: python3 studio/script_check.py NN --calibrate
en.source: ESTIMATE (not measured): typical calm documentary narration, ~150 words/min. Replaced automatically by the measured value after --calibrate.
en.note: 8-10 min at this pace = about 1,200-1,500 English script words (aim 1,275-1,425 = 8.5-9.5 min).

hi.source: EP06 owner recording: 478.4 s / 1303 script words (1326 spoken words, 0.361 s/spoken word)
hi.note: Hindi is the reference/optional second language from EP07. 8-10 min at this pace = about 1,310-1,630 Hindi script words (aim 1,390-1,550 = 8.5-9.5 min). The old 0.575 s/word guide-voice pace is retired.
